items.a: Yes. The SPA contract price is the final amount you pay. No interest, no bank fees, no insurance charges. The developer wants to sell during construction, so the instalments are interest-free.

Industry practice: 30-day delay — reminder. 60 days — 2–5% penalty on the missed instalment. 90+ days — the developer may terminate the SPA and retain 30–40% of what's been paid. The key is to negotiate a restructuring upfront.

items.q: Can I sell the unit before handover?
items.a: Yes, once 30–40% of the price is paid. This is called an assignment / re-sale. Buy at 20%, wait 1.5–2 years for growth, then sell to another buyer at +25–40%. It's a flip strategy.

items.q: Can I combine it with a mortgage after handover?
items.a: Yes. Once the property is handed over you can refinance the balance through a UAE bank. Especially attractive once you've built large equity (the property has appreciated).
DLD registration — 4% of the price (mandatory). Oqood — 0.25% (for off-plan). Developer NOC — ~500 AED. ShanGroup service — 0% (we're paid commission by the developer).

items.q: Do non-residents qualify for the instalments?
items.a: Yes. Citizens of Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and the rest of the CIS — every programme is available. No UAE visa, business or bank account is needed to sign the SPA. The visa appears automatically once equity reaches 750K AED.

items.q: What does the 10–20% down payment include?
items.a: The down payment itself + 4% DLD + 0.25% Oqood + ~1% developer admin fee. For a $400K unit: $80K (20%) + $16K DLD + $1K Oqood + $4K admin = ~$101K upfront.

items.q: Can the payment schedule be adjusted?
items.a: Standard programmes are fixed. But on larger deals ($1M+) it's negotiable — milestone payments can be shifted, post-handover extended, or a discount agreed for a single lump-sum payment.
